patent_grounding.rationale: Revision 4's modeled worm-part/peg-part recirculation features are supported by cited passages: boss redirects balls into the hole, fillet smooths the transition, and oblique hole continues into peg U-shaped helical channel. Double-profile tooth-gap description matches claims 17/19: circular side-contact profile and concave bottom clearance. No fabricated dimensions or unsupported constraints appear.

functional_completeness.rationale: Candidate represents the principal transmission elements, passive race, worm/peg components and transition features, and both swept-space tooth geometry and dependent double-profile geometry. Passive-path traversal is qualified rather than forced into one universal sequence.

flow_consistency.rationale: Ball circulation is internal cyclic motion; notes explicitly allow direct recirculation entry without passive-path traversal. Detailed boss-hole-channel transition agrees with cited evidence. Rotary transfer is consistent with worm-to-balls-to-gear transfer.

claim_traceability.rationale: Transition parts have individual part-level citations, including worm part, peg part, boss, hole, fillet, and U-channel. Double-profile step has its own citation and describes side contact and bottom non-contact. Core actions and flows are cited.

interfaces.rationale: No explicit subsystem ports/interfaces are modeled, but no incompatible connection is asserted. Ball circulation is an internal route and the candidate appropriately avoids inventing external drive/load interfaces. Lack of detailed port boundaries is acceptable for this concept-level model.

textbook_application.rationale: Consulted guidance supports distinguishing internal interactions and physical decomposition/functional allocation; it supplies no invention facts. Candidate uses physical parts and verb-noun functions and avoids unsupported interface or requirement details.

summary: Independent review of saved SJS 1.0 revision 4: added recirculation transition elements and double-profile tooth geometry are grounded in actual cited patent passages and address revision 3 completeness/traceability gaps. Structure and citations appear coherent; no unresolved errors or warnings identified. Omitted explicit ports/interfaces are acceptable because circulation is internal and no incompatible connection or unsupported external interface is asserted.
